newsitem.title: USA: Superior Services Q4 net up on acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Superior Services Q4 net up on acquisitions.

text.p: Superior Services Inc said Tuesday acquisitions made during 1996 contributed to a significant increase in net income in the fourth quarter.

The company reported net income of $3.4 million in the period ended December 31, compared with $1.5 million one year ago. Revenues totaled $31.1 million, up from $23.4 million in the fourth quarter of 1995.
Superior Services said acquisitions of solid waste businesses throughout 1996 accounted for more than half the revenue increase in the fourth quarter.
Superior Services provides solid waste processing services.
